messages:
ana: hey folks — just finished onboarding. i accepted the org invite but when i try to clone `git@github.com:redwood/infrastructure.git` i get `Permission denied (publickey)`. git clone fails. my GitHub account only shows my personal email (ana+github@gmail.com). who should i ping to link my work email or fix perms?

it-bot: automated reminder: if your org enforces SSO, enable SSO for your GitHub account after accepting the invite. docs: https://github.com/orgs/redwood/sso 

samir: quick checks: run `ssh -T git@github.com` and `git config --get user.email`. also `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` to confirm the key you added on GH matches the key on your machine. common cause is having two GH accounts. i can reissue the invite to whatever account has the key.

ana: ssh -T shows: "Hi ana! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." but clone still fails. not sure why.

samir: if `ssh -T` says you authenticated, the SSH key is fine. then it's a permissions/S SO/org-membership issue — which GitHub user is actually listed as a member of the org? run `git config --get user.email` (no keys please) and tell us the account email your local git is using.

ana: `git config --get user.email` => ana+github@gmail.com. my work email is ana@redwood.com. i think GH accepted the invite to ana@redwood.com but my local git uses the personal email.

devrel-sarah: FYI — org membership / SSO is tied to your GitHub account, not the commit email. if you have two GH accounts you can either merge them or we can re-invite the account that holds your SSH key. samir — can you re-invite the account associated with the local key (ana+github@gmail.com)?

samir: yep i can resend. also to switch local git email: `git config --global user.email \"ana@redwood.com\"`. i'll reissue an invite to ana+github@gmail.com and mark it for SSO approval.

ana: another question — i added my YubiKey to my personal account earlier. is it fine to add the same key to my work account?

quentin: don't share the security key between accounts. better to register a new key on the work account or use the company-approved key. if you need a second YubiKey, ops can help procure one. @samir can add a note to the onboarding ticket about yubikey.

samir: :thumbsup: invite resent to ana+github@gmail.com. check your inbox. once you accept i'll verify team mapping. if you still see blocks, DM me your GitHub username and i'll escalate to SSO admin.

ana: invite arrived and accepted ✅ i can now clone the repo and push to my fork. thanks everyone for the quick help :party_parrot:

quentin: welcome aboard! ping if anything else pops up
